coreRelationships: The subject's powerful physique and intense gaze (implied) convey strength and determination.
The stark black and white photography, combined with sweat and heavy shadows, creates a raw and gritty atmosphere.
The prominent gold chain and diamond ring signify status and success within the hip-hop culture.
The low-key lighting and tight cropping focus attention on the subject's physical presence and the details of his accessories.
